note: Numbers the paper states that no committed artifact can produce. Each is an observation from a live session whose raw output was not retained, recorded at the time in a dated findings-log entry or a unit-test docstring written against the live system. They are not measurements from the record and the paper must not present them as such. A record with neither an artifact nor an explicit unretained-session provenance is a build failure, so a number cannot acquire the authority of a derivation by being added here.
why_this_file_exists: This is the paper's own retention thesis arriving a second time. The rule adopted after the n=210 withdrawal was 'retain per-sample outputs for every study'. It was scoped to studies. Most of these come from diagnostic sessions against live containers, which are not studies and so were never in scope, and their raw output is gone; the rest are settings, which no analysis produces. Rather than delete the incidents or quietly present them as derived, they are quarantined here with the record that carries each one. The count is deliberately not stated: a sentence saying how many records this file holds is a hand-typed number in the file whose purpose is to stop those.
